title: Natural-Object CATEGORY Imagery Qualification on Generic Object Decoding (GOD)

terminology_binding.future_geometry_scope: category-level geometry only (C3XR-CAT); NOT exact-image C3XR

provenance.provenance_amendment: mission pinned v6; Figshare serves only v8 (v1-7 -> HTTP 404); v8 supersedes v6 and carries the corrected category_index/image_index that motivated a post-correction pin. See results/c3xb/c3xb_candidate_inventory.json.
provenance.cache_rule: only files matching pinned v8 file_id + supplied_md5 accepted; SHA-256 computed on download; no older cached GOD reused

estimator.independent_unit: 2-run pair; 10 pairs; each pair covers all 50 categories exactly once
estimator.split: 5 run-pairs half A / 5 half B => 5 reps/category/half, 250 trials/half
estimator.statistic: R_I_GOD = Pearson r of concatenated 50-category-mean patterns across halves, Spearman-Brown corrected
estimator.permutation_null: permute category identities WITHIN each run-pair; n_perm >= 1000
estimator.bootstrap: non-straddling HIERARCHICAL: fix disjoint 5v5 pair split, resample whole run-pairs within each half with replacement; n_boot >= 1000

imagery.run_pair_rule: every 2 consecutive runs cover all 50 categories exactly once

cue_leakage_audit.paradigm: 3s visual WORD cue -> 15s eyes-closed imagery -> 3s vividness
cue_leakage_audit.rule: primary reliability only if CONTROLLED (released patterns), else leakage-safe GLM from raw with separate cue/imagery/eval regressors frozen before outcomes; UNRESOLVED -> C3XB_BLOCKED_BY_CUE_PROVENANCE

subject_gate: R_I>0 AND perm p<0.05 AND bootstrap CI lower>0 AND min-over-seeds>0 -> PASS; else MARGINAL/NOISE_FLOOR (frozen c3x subject_reliability_gate)

matched_perception.statistic: R_P_category from ImageNetTest (50 cat x 35 reps), run-disjoint frozen C3X estimator
matched_perception.label: CATEGORY-MATCHED PERCEPTION

dataset_gate.qualified: >=2/5 subjects imagery PASS AND category-matched perception PASS AND cue control acceptable -> C3XB_GOD_CATEGORY_IMAGERY_QUALIFIED
dataset_gate.blocked: cue provenance UNRESOLVED and not repairable from raw -> C3XB_BLOCKED_BY_CUE_PROVENANCE
dataset_gate.authorizes_on_qualified: restricted future gate C3XR-CAT (category-level geometry) ONLY; NOT exact-image C3XR

integrity.vividness: descriptive only, after primary frozen; never used to select trials
